name: media-player
tagline: Video surface with a seek bar, hover thumbnail preview and a full control strip.
summary: A full video player assembled from parts: the seek bar previews the frame under the cursor, and a control row handles play, skip, volume, time, speed, picture-in-picture and fullscreen, with keyboard shortcuts.
appearance: From the code, a rounded video frame sits above a rounded control bar. The bar holds a thin seek slider with a hover time preview, then play, back and forward, an expandable volume control and a time readout on the left, with speed, picture-in-picture and fullscreen icons on the right.
behaviour: Hovering the seek bar shows a thumbnail and time for that spot, and clicking or dragging seeks. Play toggles, volume expands on hover, and the settings menu holds speed, quality and captions. Space, F, M, the arrows, J and L, digits and P drive the player from the keyboard.
demo_content: A stock Pexels nature clip played through the standard control bar.
search_phrases: player with speed and picture in picture
video with captions and quality menu
use_when: An app needs a real video player with seek previews, speed, captions, picture-in-picture and fullscreen.
avoid_when: It depends on media-chrome and several registry parts, so adopting it means installing four components and their deps.
customise: Compose it from parts: swap the video source, choose which controls to include, and pass label, direction, autoHide, disabled and tooltip settings on the root. Speeds and icons are in the source.
weight_why: A real video element plus a media-chrome store; the cost follows the clip being played.

a11y.note: The root is focusable with many shortcuts and icons get tooltips, but there is no reduced-motion handling for the controls.

issues: No image was recorded, so the player's look could not be checked.
polish_why: No frames exist; the code is complete and organised, but its rendered finish is unverified.
title: Media Player
